basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Sydney, Australia. I grew up in a conservative Christian household but identify as an atheist now. I'm passionate about music, especially alternative and metalcore bands like Ice Nine Kills. My interests also include exploring new tech trends and contributing to open-source projects. When I'm not coding, you can find me attending local gigs or exploring Sydney's vibrant food scene. I'm single, enjoy deep conversations about philosophy and ethics, and typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over six years. My expertise lies in web development and software architecture. I've been a tech enthusiast since my teens, always tinkering with gadgets and learning new programming languages.
